paragraphs.text: BEA reported an August goods/services deficit of US$105.6bn against revised July US$92.8bn, released October 6. Interpretation: the wider deficit merits growth/trade monitoring, but does not establish import demand quality, real GDP contribution or a stock-price direction.

paragraphs.text: Bull scenario: a less restrictive policy read could support risk appetite if verified yields and breadth improve. Bear scenario: persistent inflation concern could pressure duration-sensitive assets. Both are scenarios; no current yield/breadth confirmation is established. A policy read that conflicts with the actual release, or absent close/breadth confirmation, invalidates a directional claim.
